texts: Welcome to my website, which is designed to introduce myself.
Before your visit begins, I prefer to warn you: I am far from being a designer, and therefore I know that the design can be greatly improved.
I chose to keep it simple, quite simply so that this site finally exists, rather than waiting for it indefinitely.
My first limitation is psychological, and it took me a long time to overcome it, as they say in the IT world: the best is the enemy of the good.
Well, there you have it, I fell victim to it and postponed this launch for a long time, which unfortunately is not good.
So here it is, finally online and it's a start! If you visit regularly, you will see it evolve.
My second reason is more technical: while I hope that development becomes my primary activity, for now it is far from being so and I don't have the desired time to devote to it.

messages.visiteurs: To you who arrive here in the course of your wanderings on the web: take the time to explore! Your feedback and advice are always welcome to help me evolve this site.
messages.recruteurs: If you are here to evaluate my profile for a professional opportunity, the Background page gathers the essentials of my experience and will allow you to directly export/print my resume.

intro: Passionate about Mathematics since early childhood, I completed my initial academic curriculum in this field. This led me to pursue a Bachelor's 3rd year in Mathematics during which I discovered programming in the Relational Databases and Object-Oriented Programming module.

After several years in retail, I launched my own business. During this experience, I needed a business management tool. My programming foundations, my professional status, my limited budget, and the impossibility of finding a solution matching my expectations led me to build this tool myself rather than buy a software license.
With this goal of creation, looking for the best programming language for this project, I taught myself various languages:

languages.name: JAVA
languages.detail: in a more advanced way than the knowledge acquired during my university years.

languages.name: C++
languages.detail: Allowing the creation of executables but ultimately not suitable for building the user interface.

languages.name: Visual-Basic for Excel
languages.detail: Ultimately my choice, allowing easy user interface design, straightforward data storage, and the actual implementation of core algorithms.

outro: Following this, my professional career guided by personal needs led me to professionalize in the field of computer programming.

With this objective in mind, I completed the training that allowed me to earn the Web/Mobile Web Developer title, acquiring core skills and a structured work methodology primarily oriented toward web development.
To continue expanding my skills, I recently enrolled in a distance learning program for the Bachelor Application Developer & Designer specialized in JAVA.

sitemap-manager.title: Sitemap Manager
sitemap-manager.shortDescription: Bash CLI utility to automate XML sitemap management and lastmod tag updates.
longDescription: A DevOps productivity tool designed to run from any project directory. It features an interactive loop menu, intelligent <loc> tag detection, and robust multi-OS AWK processing handling Windows/Linux line endings.
This project also incorporates automated terminal demo generation using the VHS tool to showcase its command-line workflow.
